# The Midnight Desk

> A free browser-based noir detective puzzle game created by Dishu san.

The player investigates three mystery cases on a tactile wooden desk by dragging physical evidence and connecting related clues with red thread.

## Gameplay

- Drag papers, photographs, and case files around the investigation desk.
- Pull red thread between evidence pins to connect related clues.
- Cut incorrect threads with right-click, double-click, or a long press on touch screens.
- Complete the correct evidence sequence to close each case.

## Website

- Play: https://the-midnight-desk.vercel.app/
- No account or download is required.
- Built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
